signatureConcept: Warm-premium 'guest house for cars' — an ivory split hero with a claret-matted framed photo hands off to a full-width numbered proof ledger of the dealer's credentials, with hairline-rule surface grammar, letterspaced EB Garamond serif-caps eyebrows over sentence-case serif display, and hospitality-toned aftercare storytelling in a warm voice

coinedMoves.proof-ledger-band: full-width hairline-ruled ledger directly below the hero: numbered rows/columns of credential entries (award, review score, stock scale, aftercare) with oversized oldstyle serif numerals in brand-primary
coinedMoves.spanning-logo-plaque-two-row: header assembly where the logo sits in a full-height bordered plaque at the left edge spanning BOTH header rows (contact strip row + nav row); the brand-primary contact strip and the nav each run to the right of the plaque
